ChronoBranch for Antigravity

将 Antigravity 长对话与多分支探索，变成一条清晰直观的横向点线时间线画布

简体中文 · English · DSH 桌面端版本

--- ## 这是什么？ **ChronoBranch** 是一款面向 **Google Antigravity** 的原生 **MCP App UI 插件**。它将传统纵向无限滚动的 AI 对话记录，重组为**按时间从左向右延展的极简点线时间线画布**，让你一眼看清长对话脉络、Agent 子代理并发泳道与多分支探索结构。 --- ## 核心功能 - **极简点线时间线 & 三档缩放（L1 / L2 / L3）** - 支持滚轮无级缩放与三档快捷切换：**鸟瞰（L1）**、**点线（L2）**、**展开（L3）**。 - 点击任意节点原地展开完整对话卡片，支持完整 Markdown 渲染、代码块一键复制与四周自由拖拽缩放尺寸。 - **Agent 子代理泳道 & 执行微观小轴** - 自动解析 `invoke_subagent` 派生的子代理会话，绘制为独立并发泳道。 - 每个轮次内置**微观执行小轴**，按序记录思考推理（`thinking`）、工具调用、命令输出、文件 Diff、Agent 提问选择卡片与上下文压缩检查点，点击任意小点即可在侧边抽屉查看完整详情。 - **原生分支对话 & Cherry-Pick 结论回流** - 从任意历史节点一键发起并行分支探索，在画布上以正交树状分支呈现。 - 支持将支线验证过的结论提炼并 **Cherry-Pick 回流** 到父线上下文，并在画布上绘制虚线回流连线。 - **工作区多对话时间线关联** - 自由勾选同一工作区下的任意对话进行关联，打开其中任一对话的时间线即可同屏纵览全部关联泳道与节点。 - **悬浮磁贴 & 跨界拖出桌面独立置顶** - 将任意关键轮次固定为悬浮磁贴，支持切换「完整 / 仅 AI」、多张磁贴磁吸并排与一键定位跳回原节点。 - **跨界拖出自动脱离**：将磁贴拖出侧边栏/对话面板边界，或点击弹出按钮，自动切换为 **Windows 原生无边框置顶桌面卡片**（不占任务栏，最小化主窗口仍保留，方便边看论文/代码边对照）。 - **原生深浅色主题 & 中英双语同步** - 自动跟随 Antigravity 的浅色 / 深色主题与界面语言（中文 / 标准英文）。 --- ## 安装方式（无需构建，开箱即用） 本仓库已包含预构建的自包含单文件产物（`dist/server.mjs` 与 `dist/app.html`），无需安装依赖或编译。 ### 方式一：一行命令克隆安装（推荐） **Windows (PowerShell)：** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/yoli-mi/antigravity-chronobranch.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\chronobranch" ``` **macOS / Linux：** ```bash git clone https://github.com/yoli-mi/antigravity-chronobranch.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/chronobranch ``` Antigravity 会自动发现 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/chronobranch/` 下的插件（无需手动编辑配置文件）： 1. 在任意对话右上侧辅助栏点击 **`+` → Timeline**（侧边视图），或 2. 在左侧导航栏点击 **ChronoBranch**（全屏画布视图），或 3. 直接对 Agent 说「打开 ChronoBranch 时间线」。 ### 方式二：源码构建安装 需要 Node.js >= 20 与 pnpm： ```bash git clone https://github.com/yoli-mi/antigravity-chronobranch.git cd antigravity-chronobranch pnpm install pnpm run install:antigravity ``` 卸载： ```bash pnpm run uninstall:antigravity ``` --- ## 项目结构 ```text antigravity-chronobranch/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity 插件清单 ├── mcp_config.json # MCP App 服务配置（使用 ${PLUGIN_ROOT} / ${PLUGIN_DATA}） ├── assets/logo.svg # 插件图标 ├── dist/ │ ├── server.mjs # 预构建自包含 Node.js MCP 服务端 │ └── app.html # 预构建单文件严格 CSP 兼容 UI 应用 ├── src/ │ ├── antigravity/ │ │ ├── server.ts # MCP App 服务端与工具定义 │ │ ├── transcript-adapter.ts # Antigravity transcript.jsonl 解析与 UCGS 图谱构建 │ │ ├── meta-store-file.ts # 持久化元数据仓库（${PLUGIN_DATA}） │ │ └── app.tsx # @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps 前端入口 │ ├── core/ # 跨平台统一时间线画布、布局、样式、双语词典与 Markdown 渲染 │ ├── client/ # 悬浮磁贴状态与交互覆盖层（支持跨界拖出） │ └── host/wpf-tile-script.ts # Windows 原生无边框桌面置顶磁贴宿主 └── scripts/ # 打包与安装脚本 ``` --- ## 开源协议 基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 开源。如果这个项目帮到了你，欢迎点个 **Star ⭐** 支持一下！

en:
ChronoBranch for Antigravity

Turn long Antigravity conversations, subagents, and parallel branches into a clean horizontal dot-and-line timeline canvas

简体中文 · English · DSH Desktop Edition

--- ## Overview **ChronoBranch** is a native **MCP App UI Plugin** for **Google Antigravity**. It transforms long linear AI chat logs into a **left-to-right horizontal dot-and-line timeline canvas**, giving you instant spatial clarity across multi-turn chats, spawned subagent swimlanes, and parallel branch explorations. --- ## Key Features - **Minimalist Dot-and-Line Timeline & 3-Tier Zoom (`L1` / `L2` / `L3`)** - Smooth wheel zoom plus instant presets: **Overview (`L1`)**, **Dot-Line (`L2`)**, and **Expanded (`L3`)**. - Click any turn to expand a full resizable dialog sheet with Markdown rendering and one-click code copy. - **Subagent Swimlanes & Execution Micro-Axis** - Automatically detects `invoke_subagent` conversations and renders them as live concurrent swimlanes attached to their spawning turn. - Unfold any turn's **Execution Micro-Axis** to inspect reasoning (`thinking`), tool calls, command outputs, file edits, interactive agent choices, and context compaction checkpoints. - **Native Branching & Cherry-Pick Merge** - Fork a new parallel conversation branch from any turn and visualize branches as an orthogonal tree. - Synthesize verified branch findings and **Cherry-Pick Merge** them back into the parent conversation with a visual merge connector. - **Workspace Multi-Conversation Linking** - Link any number of conversations in your workspace to view all of their timelines together on a single canvas. - **Floating Magnetic Tiles & Drag-Out Desktop Sticky Cards** - Pin any turn as a floating tile (`Full` / `AI Only`, side-by-side snapping, instant locate). - **Seamless Edge Breakout**: Drag a tile past the edge of the side pane—or click the pop-out button—to detach it into a **frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop sticky card** (zero taskbar clutter, stays visible even when Antigravity is minimized). - **Live Theme & Bilingual (`en` / `zh`) Sync** - Automatically follows Antigravity's light/dark theme tokens and active locale. --- ## Quick Install (Zero Build Required) Prebuilt self-contained bundles (`dist/server.mjs` and `dist/app.html`) are committed directly in this repository—no `npm install` or compilation needed. ### Option 1: One-Line Git Clone (Recommended) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/yoli-mi/antigravity-chronobranch.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\chronobranch" ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/yoli-mi/antigravity-chronobranch.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/chronobranch ``` Antigravity discovers `~/.gemini/config/plugins/chronobranch/` automatically: 1. Click **`+` → Timeline** in the conversation side pane, or 2. Click **ChronoBranch** in the left sidebar for a full-page canvas, or 3. Ask the agent to *"Open the ChronoBranch timeline"*. ### Option 2: Build from Source Requires Node.js >= 20 and pnpm: ```bash git clone https://github.com/yoli-mi/antigravity-chronobranch.git cd antigravity-chronobranch pnpm install pnpm run install:antigravity ``` To uninstall: ```bash pnpm run uninstall:antigravity ``` --- ## License Released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). If ChronoBranch improves your workflow, consider leaving a **Star ⭐**!
